title: Cyberpartisanen and Silent Crow claim they took Russian war-death records from Rosstat; Spiegel reports nine Germans among the dead
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (23 November); the day of the intrusion is not stated.
geo_basis: country of the agency (Rosstat, Russia's statistics agency) as the source states it
summary: ORF reports that the Belarusian group Cyberpartisanen and the Ukrainian group Silent Crow took death records from the servers of Russia's statistics agency Rosstat and gave them to selected media, including Spiegel. Spiegel says the records list nine Germans among Russian war dead, men who evidently fought for Russia against Ukraine. Rosstat's response is not given.
plain: Two hacker groups say they took Russian war-death records from the statistics agency Rosstat and passed them to media. Spiegel reports they list nine Germans.
exec: A claimed hack of a Russian state agency's servers has exposed war-death records, according to ORF's report of Spiegel's account.

validation.note: Only ORF.at was read. n-tv.de could not be fetched; hna.de, merkur.de and others carry the same story but were not read. Rosstat's own statement was not found.
